# C math functions whose results aren't exactly specified, so platforms can disagree in
# the last bits. The single source for:
#   - build.sh: -fno-builtin-<name>{,f,l} for each, so clang never folds them at build time
#   - fold-canary.sh: a constant-argument call to each (double and float) that must survive
#
# Format: name, arity (1 or 2), then optional flags:
#   nocanary  no direct canary call, because <cmath> doesn't declare it. exp10 is reached
#             through pow(10, x); sincos is formed from separate sin and cos calls.
#
# The libm shim exports every one of these that OCCT imports.
sin 1
cos 1
tan 1
asin 1
acos 1
atan 1
atan2 2
sinh 1
cosh 1
tanh 1
asinh 1
acosh 1
atanh 1
exp 1
exp2 1
expm1 1
exp10 1 nocanary
log 1
log10 1
log2 1
log1p 1
cbrt 1
pow 2
hypot 2
sincos 1 nocanary
# Not exported by the shim yet, because OCCT doesn't import them. If a library ever
# does, check-math-imports.sh fails and the shim gains the function.
erf 1
erfc 1
tgamma 1
lgamma 1
